svg.title: Figure 15 · Raw SVI calibration with withheld strikes
svg.desc: 17 deterministic noisy IV quotes on k in [-0.4,0.4]; indices congruent to 2 modulo 4 are withheld. Fit minimizes equal-weight squared total-variance residuals on 13 calibration quotes using four optimizer starts. One IV basis point is 0.0001 decimal volatility.
